snippet.title: Burger Bois | Frosty Games Fest 2025
snippet.description:
Featured in Frosty Games Fest 2025! Watch the full showcase here: https://youtu.be/3ff3YxX7Cgw

Take a look at a mouth-watering new trailer for Burger Bois, the juiciest food truck sim this side of Aotearoa! This fresh look includes some never-before-seen ingredients like Radicchio, Kimchi, Shaved Truffles and even Waffle buns, while revisiting what’ll make this a sim to savour – freeform burger crafting, strangely relatable customers and plenty of pickles, thank you!

Wishlist: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3224290/Burger_Bois/

Find more games made in Australia and Aotearoa New Zealand on our Steam event page here: https://store.steampowered.com/curator/45423962/sale/FrostyGamesCelebration
